author: Athul Prem
scope: The endpoint change subtracts 995 MHz from 1000 MHz. The midpoint departure subtracts the average of those endpoints from 997.5 MHz. Spatial changes subtract the coarser mesh from the finer mesh. The transmission offset residual is the exact three-sample lower bound on the maximum absolute residual from any frequency-independent additive T offset. The five-input mean uses equal incoherent powers. These are finite samples on one fixed-facet geometry. Behavior between samples, continuum accuracy and linewidth or Q remain unresolved.
